summary:
I've worked through the CRC outreach worklist for 'Okafor CRC 2026' (13 members) under RBC-QM-02. Eight patients have an open gap; each now has a mailed FIT kit order (LAB-FIT-KIT, routine, 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31) and a portal message saying the kit is on its way and how to collect and return it. None of the eight had an active FIT order before. Four patients are excluded and one is not in the population. No member is up to date on screening. I placed no orders and sent no messages for anyone without an open gap, and wrote nothing about pt-0037.

| Patient | Age at 12/31/26 | Status | Reason | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Excluded | Age 66+, has an active frailty diagnosis (since 2025-09) and takes a dementia drug (donepezil, active since 2025-06, for Alzheimer dementia). | None |
| pt-0011 Marilu Gaona | 62 | Open gap | No qualifying test on record. Her hospice care ended 2025-10-20, before 2026, so it doesn't exclude her. | FIT sr-t0001, message comm-t0009 |
| pt-0014 Santo Pagac | 55 | Open gap | A colonoscopy was ordered (sr-00002) but he missed the 2026-04-14 appointment, so no test was done. An order doesn't count as screening. | FIT sr-t0002, message comm-t0010 |
| pt-0018 Lance Muller | 53 | Open gap | His Cologuard-type stool DNA test sample was collected 2023-12-27 (resulted 2024-01-08). That is before the 2024–2026 window. His other FIT was in 2021. | FIT sr-t0003, message comm-t0011 |
| pt-0019 Harrison O'Keefe | 69 | Open gap | He has frailty, but no advanced illness and no dementia drug in 2025–26 (donepezil stopped 2023-03; testing showed mild cognitive impairment, not dementia). No screening on record. | FIT sr-t0004, message comm-t0012 |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | Hospice care from 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21 (pancreatic cancer). | None |
| pt-0021 Ángela Vigil | 52 | Excluded | Total proctocolectomy in 2015, documented in a scanned outside operative report (doc-00059). | None |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap | Her last FIT sample was collected 2025-12-29 and resulted 2026-01-05. Collection was before 2026, so it doesn't count. Her oral cancer history is not colorectal and doesn't exclude her. | FIT sr-t0005, message comm-t0013 |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap | Her last stool blood test (FOBT) was 2024-06-11, outside 2026. A colonoscopy order from 2025 (sr-00003) was never done. | FIT sr-t0006, message comm-t0014 |
| pt-0034 Rickey Sipes | 72 | Excluded | Age 66+ and lives long term at Maple Grove Care Center. His home address is Room 214 there, with nursing facility visits in Feb and Jul 2026. | None |
| pt-0035 Elvin Wolff | 68 | Open gap | His May 2026 skilled nursing stay was short-term rehab after hip surgery, and he went home afterward. He has no frailty or other exclusion and no screening on record. | FIT sr-t0007, message comm-t0015 |
| pt-0036 Nick Bartoletti | 53 | Open gap | His 2021 sigmoid colectomy removed only part of the colon, which doesn't exclude him. No screening on record. | FIT sr-t0008, message comm-t0016 |
| pt-0037 Fumiko Pouros | 35 | Not in population | Younger than 46 at the end of 2026. | None |

**Points to decide:**
- **Patients with open colonoscopy orders:** pt-0014 and pt-0024 still have those orders active alongside the new FIT orders. I left them as they are; you may want to decide whether to keep or close them.
- **Check I skipped:** I searched the whole clinic for stool tests by their standard lab codes and read every note and report for the open-gap patients. I did not go through every individual lab result for each patient, so a stool test filed under an unusual code could have been missed.
